# Cheat Sheet

A quick reference for everyday BergAgents usage.

## 📋 Common Slash Commands (TUI / Web)

  | Command               | Description                        |
  | --------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
  | `/help`               | List all available commands        |
  | `/agents`             | Show registered agents             |
  | `/models`             | Show loaded models (web UI only)   |
  | `/stats`              | Show learning statistics           |
  | `/tools`              | List available tools               |
  | `/health`             | System health check                |
  | `/history`            | Show task transcript               |
  | `/memory`             | Memory stats                       |
  | `/context`            | Current context                    |
  | `/settings`           | Show current settings              |
  | `/plugins`            | List loaded plugins                |
  | `/skills`             | List registered skills             |
  | `/mcps`               | MCP server status                  |
  | `/harness` or `/task` | Execute a task through the Harness |
  | `/clear`              | Clear session state                |

## 📡 API Endpoints (REST)

  | Method   | Path                               | Purpose                                   |
  | -------- | ------                             | ---------                                 |
  | POST     | `/api/harness`                     | Run a task; returns result dict           |
  | POST     | `/api/harness/{thread_id}/stream`  | Start a streaming worker                  |
  | GET      | `/api/harness/{thread_id}/events`  | SSE stream of task events                 |
  | POST     | `/api/harness/{thread_id}/respond` | Answer a HITL pause (approve/reject/edit) |
  | GET      | `/api/learning-stats`              | Get learning/outcome statistics           |
  | GET/POST | `/api/providers`                   | List or modify provider registry          |
  | GET      | `/api/providers/active`            | Show active provider                      |
  | GET      | `/api/agents`                      | List all agents                           |
  | GET      | `/api/agents/{name}`               | Get detailed agent info                   |
  | POST/GET | `/api/threads`                     | Manage conversation threads               |
  | POST     | `/api/threads/{id}/cancel`         | Cancel a running thread                   |
  | POST     | `/api/threads/{id}/export`         | Export thread transcript                  |

## ⚙️ Configuration Layers (order of precedence)

1. **Explicit dict** passed to `BergAgentsApp.create()` (highest).
2. **Environment variables** (`BERG_AGENT_*`).
3. **`.env`** file (plain key-value pairs).
4. **`../.berg-agents`** (default config).

## 🗝️ Common Environment Variables

  | Variable                 | Meaning                                                        |
  | ----------               | ---------                                                      |
  | `OPENAI_API_KEY`         | API key for OpenAI models (`${env:OPENAI_API_KEY}` in config). |
  | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`      | API key for Anthropic.                                         |
  | `BERG_AGENT_MCP_SERVERS` | Path to MCP JSONC config file.                                 |

## ✅ Quick Checklist Before Committing

- [ ] Code passes `ruff check` and `ruff format --check`.
- [ ] Unit tests exist and run (`pytest`).
- [ ] Documentation pages updated (new API, tutorials, or changes).
- [ ] Version bump in `pyproject.toml` and `../.berg-agents`.
- [ ] Changelog entry added.
- [ ] All new concepts documented in the appropriate tutorial or best-practice page.
